workarounds.symptom: `login rema1000` fails on Windows with `CredWrite` error 1783 ("The stub received bad data")
workarounds.workaround: Fix: 🐛 Save a long login in the Windows keychain. Target files: pyproject.toml, src/handle_mcp/cli.py, src/handle_mcp/stores/__init__.py. Windows Credential Manager holds 2560 bytes per entry, and keyring writes UTF-16: about 1280 characters. A REMA 1000 session is 2503 characters as saved (measured in a real one), so `handle-mcp login rema1000` could not save on Windows. The Windows backend also raises its own error type, not a `KeyringError`, so the human saw a traceback. (Ref: https://github.com/NJohansen/handle-mcp/pull/153)

workarounds.symptom: Windows: server fails on startup with ZoneInfoNotFoundError (missing tzdata dependency)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: 🐛 Make the server work on Windows. Target files: pyproject.toml, src/handle_mcp/stores/__init__.py, .github/workflows/ci.yml. The server crashed on import on Windows. A new `windows-latest` CI job then found two more Windows bugs. This PR fixes all three. (Ref: https://github.com/NJohansen/handle-mcp/pull/92)
